summary: The diff demonstrates comprehensive implementation of all requirements to fix the Featured Products section to display all 18 products. The changes include extensive debugging in useQueries.ts to trace backend data fetching, removal of artificial limits in FeaturedProducts.tsx, image mappings for all 12 new products in ProductCard.tsx, and enhanced logging throughout the data flow pipeline. All requirements appear to be addressed with proper implementation evidence.

hallucinated_features.description: Added extensive console.log debugging statements throughout multiple components with visual separators and detailed tracing
hallucinated_features.reason: While debugging logs help verify the requirements, the BuildRequest does not explicitly request adding extensive console logging infrastructure. REQ-34's AC mentions 'Console logs show successful fetching' but this could refer to verifying existing logs rather than adding new comprehensive logging throughout the entire data flow pipeline.
